book.name: Amatiu
book.title: Ib̠eb̠i Asu̠gbagba Ma̠ Agu̠o̠ Amatiu Age̠ Bho̠

content: Eru bho̠ Ad̠agi̠an A̠zizo̠s
D̠a̠ obhel obha̠, sa̠ E̠mu̠gh bho̠ a̠rileghom A̠zizo̠s agi̠ d̠a̠ e̠ghana ma̠ eru bho̠ ma̠ o̠d̠agi̠an O̠yo̠.
Sa̠ i̠na a̠ne ma̠ o̠ko̠i̠ tu̠tu̠n eruba̠l a̠d̠uga̠la̠n na̠ etita̠n, sa̠ o̠ko̠i̠ a̠d̠ighi i̠na.
Sa̠ o̠ni̠ ad̠agi̠an bho̠ a̠ru ra̠ a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ i̠na ma̠a̠, “Agu̠o̠ anwa i̠ro̠ ma̠ o̠nyi̠ ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠, bha̠ ruome ma̠ ikpo i̠gbaki̠ghe̠ i̠nye̠n etenegia̠n ed̠ia̠n.”
Sa̠ A̠zizo̠s awo̠ran ma̠a̠:

content.text: “Na̠ o̠ge̠ oguri ma̠a̠: ‘O̠nyi̠o̠mo̠ro̠ni̠ ko obhin d̠o̠ d̠a̠ od̠e ed̠ia̠n ku̠ku̠m a̠d̠um, ya̠a̠ d̠a̠ eb̠la̠ ikpo a̠fugh ya̠ na̠ emite d̠a̠ o̠nu̠ ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠.’

content: O̠tu̠o̠no̠m i̠se̠, sa̠ eru bho̠ a̠bhin i̠na agi̠ d̠a̠ e̠ma e̠tu̠tu̠ bho̠ ka̠ amarame̠ni̠ d̠a̠ asi̠kaka otu ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠,
sa̠ eru bho̠ a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ I̠na ma̠a̠: “Agu̠o̠ anwa i̠ro̠ ma̠ o̠nyi̠ ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠, bha̠ pele ma̠ a̠sor. Ezin bho̠, na̠ o̠ge̠ oguri ma̠a̠:

content.text: “ ‘I̠na ta̠ a̠ruom itileduom bho̠ ma̠ okponom Oyom,
sa̠ ta̠ e̠su̠ar anwa d̠a̠ aru̠gu̠o̠ d̠awa,
b̠o̠ka̠ anwa na̠ od̠ighia̠nma̠ ma̠ a̠wel d̠a̠ o̠gbaki̠ghe̠.’

content: Sa̠ A̠zizo̠s awo̠ran i̠na ma̠a̠:

content.text: “Na̠ o̠ge̠ oguri nyen ma̠a̠: ‘Ko o̠d̠agi̠an Wa̠nwuna̠ A̠zib̠a̠ d̠oyom!’

content: D̠a̠ o̠tu̠o̠no̠m i̠se̠, sa̠ eru bho̠ a̠bhin I̠na agi̠ d̠a̠ anyu̠ igu ola̠ amar agi̠ ma̠ anyu̠ sa̠ atu̠o̠gho̠m a̠leriom I̠na ma̠ eb̠la̠ ra̠dila̠de irileghom e̠mara̠nwunom bho̠ na̠ isosorogia̠n d̠awa,
sa̠ a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ I̠na ma̠a̠: “Ami̠ ta̠ a̠nigha̠ Nyam eb̠la̠ i̠di̠ar i̠nye̠n, ka̠ Anwa ikpud̠ia̠n i̠ko̠l ami̠.”
Sa̠ A̠zizo̠s awo̠ran ma̠a̠:

content.text: “Eru, tene ma̠ ad̠u̠a! Na̠ o̠ge̠ oguri ma̠a̠: ‘Ko̠le̠ ma̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ A̠zib̠a̠ d̠oyom ma̠ a̠gir a̠nigha̠ I̠na ku̠ku̠m.’

content: Sa̠ eru bho̠ a̠ten ad̠u̠a. I̠se̠ d̠a̠ onin obhel bho̠, sa̠ itileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ iru ra̠ i̠lo̠gh agu̠o̠ inigha̠ i̠na.
O̠ke̠ Ogir ta̠ A̠zizo̠s
Igiel bho̠ u̠gba unigha̠ I̠na ma̠ na̠ o̠d̠u̠o̠m Azo̠n d̠a̠ ikoli bho̠, sa̠ I̠na ad̠u̠a agi̠ d̠a̠ Agalili.
Sa̠ i̠na awe̠le̠ ma̠ Anazare̠t agi̠ ka̠ a̠rugh d̠a̠ Akapanu̠m d̠a̠ aka abadi̠ d̠a̠ ebhugh Aze̠bu̠lo̠n na̠ Anaftalai̠,
ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ omuzoghod̠iom iwowa̠ ta̠ owil Azaya ma̠a̠:

content.text: d̠a̠ akagara esoroma̠ abadi̠ wa̠ d̠a̠ aku̠b̠o̠ Azo̠dan bho̠,
Agalili esi wa̠ ogbo ya̠ o̠ro̠ d̠o̠ ma̠ anwi̠i̠ny a̠rughun A̠zu na̠ erugh bho̠.
A̠nwunom ya̠ na̠ erugh d̠a̠ azi̠m bho̠,
na̠ e̠bi̠gh e̠b̠alab̠al ola̠ na̠ awar ibom.
Ogbo ya̠ na̠ erugh d̠a̠ eghighira̠ okokogh omugh bho̠ eka̠,

content: Ob̠eton obhel obha̠, sa̠ A̠zizo̠s ake̠ ma̠ o̠gba orile ma̠a̠:

content.text: “Itiba̠ra̠ d̠a̠ i̠karabh, ezin bho̠ irileghom ote̠nai̠ny na̠ a̠tua̠n!”

content: A̠zizo̠s A̠bhelegi Ma̠ I̠pu̠r Ogbo I̠tu̠o̠no̠m D̠o̠yo̠
Sa̠ A̠zizo̠s a̠rile agbal Abadi̠ Agalili, sa̠ abi̠gh i̠wal a̠rumor, Asai̠mo̠n wa̠ ubhelegi ma̠ A̠pita̠ bho̠ na̠ Anduru umor d̠o̠yo̠ ka̠ na̠ erobh o̠gbo̠ d̠a̠ abadi̠ bho̠. Awa i̠ku̠ ma̠ i̠ku̠.
Sa̠ i̠na a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ awa ma̠a̠,

content.text: “I̠tu̠o̠no̠me̠ Ami̠, sa̠ Ami̠ ta̠ a̠tenemeni inyin i̠ku̠ ma̠ i̠ku̠ a̠nwunom.”

content: I̠se̠ onin obhel bho̠, sa̠ awa i̠we̠le̠ ma̠ i̠gbo̠ d̠awa iten ogbo i̠tu̠o̠no̠m D̠o̠yo̠.

O̠d̠u̠a i̠se̠ o̠gi̠ d̠a̠ ed̠ia̠, sa̠ abi̠gh ipa̠n i̠wal a̠rumor, A̠zemsi o̠nyi̠ ta̠ Aze̠bidi na̠ Azo̠n umor d̠o̠yo̠ d̠a̠ ologi oghugh na̠ o̠we̠de̠ d̠awa Aze̠bidi, na̠ e̠tu̠ghu̠man i̠gbo̠ d̠awa, sa̠ a̠bhelegi awa.
Sa̠ awa i̠we̠le̠ epa̠ ma̠ oghugh bho̠ na̠ o̠we̠de̠ d̠awa iten ogbo i̠tu̠o̠no̠m D̠o̠yo̠.
A̠zizo̠s Atu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠ sa̠ A̠koko ma̠ O̠lo̠gh A̠nwunom

Sa̠ A̠zizo̠s a̠rile d̠a̠ eb̠la̠ Agalili atu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠ d̠a̠ ru̠gala d̠awa, sa̠ agba ma̠ ib̠eb̠i asu̠gbagba irileghom bho̠, sa̠ a̠koko ma̠ eb̠la̠ a̠d̠ien kere kere asu̠nwe̠r na̠ eb̠la̠ a̠d̠ien kere kere ali̠gam a̠ruzu ya̠ na̠ e̠te̠i̠ a̠nwunom bho̠.

Sa̠ o̠du̠ D̠o̠yo̠ asasaragi̠an d̠a̠ eb̠la̠ A̠siria̠, sa̠ awa ibhin eb̠la̠ ogbo ya̠ na̠ e̠nwe̠r a̠d̠ien kere kere rasu̠nwe̠r na̠ i̠nyo̠gho̠nyo̠gh ali̠gam a̠ruzu, na̠ ogbo ya̠ a̠ruru na̠ e̠b̠am, na̠ ogbo ya̠ na̠ e̠nwe̠r asu̠nwe̠r ena̠ bho̠, na̠ ogbo ya̠ a̠risi ozu na̠ eb̠ogina̠, sa̠ i̠na a̠koko awa.
Sa̠ obom o̠lo̠gh a̠nwunom d̠a̠ Agalili, na̠ Ebhugh A̠d̠iobh Re̠ma, na̠ A̠zeruse̠le̠m, na̠ A̠zudia̠, na̠ re̠ma ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ e̠b̠e̠ye̠ma Azo̠dan bho̠, i̠tu̠o̠no̠m I̠na.

footnotes.text: O̠lo̠gho̠m d̠a̠ atu̠ghan Ubhin d̠a̠ Azaya 9:1.
